recommendations: Julia Valenti “I had the pleasure of working closely with Adi Prashanth during his summer internship at Cisco Systems. Adi's passion for software engineering is truly remarkable. He joined our team as an intern and quickly became an invaluable member. His dedication to learning and adapting to new challenges was evident from day one. Adi took on the task of developing a terminal-based command line interface for one of our projects, even though it was in a programming language he hadn't worked with before. His ability to grasp complex concepts and apply them to real-world projects was impressive. Throughout his internship, I had the privilege of mentoring Adi, and I was continually impressed by his growth and development. He is not only a talented software engineer but also a dedicated and collaborative team member. Adi Prashanth is poised for a bright future in software engineering. I have no doubt that he will excel in any endeavor he chooses to pursue. It is my pleasure to recommend him for any academic or professional opportunity.”
